content.text:
Does this text message actually offer that CO will call THEM — Cue proposing to place an outbound call to the person, not just telling them how they can call Cue themselves — in any wording, even indirectly (e.g. "I'm here if you want to talk this through")? Not just related to talking or listening in general — specifically Cue offering to call them.

Message: "Fair. So, actually: happy birthday. A morning like that, phone off, water in front of you, after the stretch you've been grinding through, that's not a small thing. Glad you got it.

And good for you for calling it with your team. Running on empty for months and then actually saying "I need two weeks" takes more than people give it credit for. I hope you let the first few days be genuinely unproductive before the recharging even starts."

Return ONLY "yes" or "no".
